preconditions.description: The number of tiles n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(tile in {1, 2} for tile in tiles)

postconditions.description: The output permutation has the same length as the input tiles.
The output permutation contains the same elements as the input tiles.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in {1, 2} for i in range(len(output)))
postconditions.description: Each element in the output permutation is either 1 or 2.

postconditions.expression: max_primes(output) == max(max_primes(perm) for perm in permutations(tiles))
postconditions.description: The number of prime prefix sums in the output permutation is maximized.
